en: A colorized panoramic view of a historic European city with red-tiled roofs, several church towers, and a hilly green landscape in the background. A tall tower with an onion-shaped dome dominates the right side, while a large multi-story building and smaller shops line the foreground. The scene has the look of an early 20th‑century printed postcard. At the top left, the word "GRAZ." is printed in red capital letters.
